metadata.description: Version-matched manuscript PDF and self-contained arXiv source bundle for the BigBounce DESI DR1 / DESIVAST spiral-chirality environment test. The manuscript reports an exploratory, post-hoc, catalog-specific non-detection: classifier-labelled spiral CW fraction shows no detectable difference between released DESIVAST void and non-void arms. It is a statement about classifier labels and released redshift-space environment assignments, not a physical-handedness, real-space, or cosmological constraint. Not peer reviewed.
metadata.title: A Catalog-Native DESIVAST Test of Classifier-Labelled Spiral Chirality in DESI DR1
